output: html_document
params:
 config_path: "configs/project.yml"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(yaml); library(fs); library(rprojroot)
})

# Find the repository root once using robust criteria (any that match will work)
root <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir(".git") |
    rprojroot::has_file(".here") |                               # optional sentinel file
    rprojroot::has_file("Soundscape-Analysis-Rare-Bird-Detection.Rproj")
)

# Knit as if we’re at the repo root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)

# Helper: load config using absolute path anchored at `root`
load_config <- function(cfg = "configs/project.yml") {
  cfg_path <- if (fs::is_absolute_path(cfg)) cfg else fs::path(root, cfg)
  if (!fs::file_exists(cfg_path)) stop("Config not found: ", cfg_path)
  yaml::read_yaml(cfg_path)
}

config <- load_config(params$config_path)
```

## Ensure pipeline ran

```{r}
indices_daily <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(config$outputs$processed_dir, "indices_daily.parquet"))
```

## Plots

```{r}
plot_index_timeseries(indices_daily)

ggplot(indices_daily, aes(day, mean, color = index)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```
